evidence: Modifies PSBT creation and export behavior in src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, src/psbt.h, and wallet-facing GUI dialogs.
rationale: Resolves hardware wallet signing failures caused by defaulting to PSBTv2 when external signers only support PSBTv0. According to the description, 'Many hardware wallets and external signing tools do not support BIP-370 (PSBTv2)', creating incompatibilities for GUI users exporting transactions.
